request.purpose: Audit actual GW001 competition fields in Results and Match Report
request.sql: SELECT 'results' AS source, competition_key, competition_group, sm_action, sm_country, sm_division, competition_stage, competition_group_name, competition_round, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `GW001_IMC Results` GROUP BY competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division,competition_stage,competition_group_name,competition_round UNION ALL SELECT 'match_report' AS source, competition_key, competition_group, sm_action, sm_country, sm_division, competition_stage, competition_group_name, competition_round, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` GROUP BY competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_country,sm_division,competition_stage,competition_group_name,competition_round ORDER BY competition_key,source
